answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 64930 Country: India Title: How to pay the zakah of previous years? Question: (1) I did not pay my full zakah last year. How can I pay now? (2) I am in big trouble in work, can you please advise me to get out of problem in life. Answer ID: 64930 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 809/970/L=09/1437) (1) Whatsoever zakah of last year is pending, you should pay them now, it shall be paid. (2) Offer salah regularly. Pray Allah and have the belief that all is from Allah. Also observe patience for the same. Also read Surah Waqia after Maghrib salah as well as ask your family members to do the same. Also read Ya Mughni ( يا مغني ) 1111 times after Isha Salah with durood 11-11 times before and after. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
